Import gathered JSON and Poster song XML/JSON

Pick inserts new slide; does not replace deck
Find by title, book, or number

Edit and delete library songs

One review screen; checklist all checked; no-lyrics title_only default; title-match keep_both default with number/lyrics; single clean skips review; multi-song waits for Import; library POST only — DeckBuilder untouched. todos.content: When adding a song slide, offer Pick from library (default) and Import a file. Importing while adding a slide shows Also save to my library checked by default on the same screen. Chosen song becomes a new slide in the open deck and does not replace the deck.
todos.notes: QA loop 9 PASS AC-007/009/014 + REQ-007/008/010/017. Pick default; Import + Also save default checked and save follows box; insert splice keeps other slides; empty library points to Import/Add by hand. Regression: top-level Load still replaces for song files; stagedSongSlide/Present + import-save prompt tests green; librarySongId optional.

todos.content: Library search matches title, book, number, and lyrics. Results show title, book, and number. Shared titles show the first verse inline. Enter or double-click inserts a linked slide after the current slide.
todos.notes: QA loop 11 PASS (independent re-verify) AC-008/012/016 + REQ-009/014/015/020 (AC-007 insert/link; AC-013 link portion). Search title/book/number/lyrics; shared titles first verse inline; Enter/double-click; librarySongId set; insert after current via splice (no deck replace). AC-013 REQ-016 hand-edit ask deferred to linked-update-decks.

todos.content: Add a library page reachable from the main menu and from Add song slide, with the same search list plus Add, Edit, Delete, Import, and a used-in-N-decks count.
todos.notes: QA loop 13 PASS AC-017 + REQ-011/021 (AC-010 edit/delete available; deck-update-after-confirm deferred to linked-update-decks). Reachable from Layout nav (main menu) + Home song-library-link + Add song slide. Search parity with picker: same GET /library/songs?q= + book filter + first-verse helpers. usedInDeckCount via ?usage=1 / countUsageBySongId (once per deck). Delete: DELETE songs only / jsonLibraryDeleteSong filters songs; presentations/slides untouched (REQ-016 safety).

todos.notes: QA loop 15 PASS AC-010/013/018 + REQ-012/015/016/023. Unused edit/delete: no deck prompt. Used: UpdateDecksPrompt checkboxes; apply only selected. Hand-edited: second confirm before overwrite/remove. Delete skips slide removal unless decks selected. Unlinked/legacy untouched; librarySongId kept on edit sync. Persist/open/Present: upsertPresentationWithDb deck_json round-trip + stagedSongSlide probe green.

todos.content: Leave Present song staging as title then two lyric lines per stage. Do not change that layout in this epic.
todos.notes: QA loop 17 PASS AC-011 / REQ-013. Independent vs main: Present/ NO DIFF; stagedSongSlide.ts NO DIFF; applyPresentPayload.ts NO DIFF; PresentTypes additive librarySongId? only. Regression: library-linked + linked-update slides still title then two lyric lines (7 stagedSongSlide tests).
